node.statement: Factorization and ledger. For n=1, node 1.1.1 makes mu_1:B->directsum S_{Pi_j,Pi_k} a linear bijection; the hypothesis that every gamma_jk is bijective makes Gamma_1 a linear bijection; and node 1.1.2 makes alpha_1:directsum S_{P_j,P_k}->A a linear bijection. Therefore gamma=alpha_1 Gamma_1 mu_1 is bijective. Because the datum fixes the same four level-one maps at all levels, the assembled gamma_n equals I_n tensor gamma. Let e_* be the minimum of e_blk, the preliminary-modulus and quadratic-bootstrap thresholds, and the fixed universal admissibility ceiling implicit in the epsilon-C* and compressed-corner definitions; choose a_merge within this universal ceiling (together with the standing admissible epsilon range) and C_merge=max{K_hom,K_norm,3}. Nodes 1.2 and 1.3 then say every amplification is a C_merge(rho+epsilon)-inclusion, and bijectivity of gamma makes it an extended C_merge(rho+epsilon)-isomorphism by def-extended-delta-inclusion.
